nodes.statement:
For all integers $k,n \geqslant 1$ such that $k = o(\sqrt{\log{n}})$, there exists a $(r,t,k)$-cluster packing graph $G$ with parameters 
	\[
		r = \frac{n}{2^{\Theta(\sqrt{\log{n} \cdot \log{k}})}} \quad and \quad t = \frac{n}{2^{\Theta(\sqrt{\log{n} \cdot \log{k}})}}. 
	\]

nodes.statement:
For all integers $k,n \geqslant 1$ such that $k = o(\frac{\log{n}}{\log\log{n}})$, there exists a $(r,t,k)$-cluster packing graph $G$ with parameters 
	\[
		r = \frac{n}{2k^2} \cdot (1-o(1)) \quad and \quad t = n^{\Omega(1/\log\log{n})}. 
	\]

nodes.name: Lemma 6.15, Section 6.4: Player Elimination Protocol Introduced in Proved in
nodes.statement:
For any $p \geqslant 2$, any deterministic protocol $\ensuremath{\pi}$ that outputs the value of $\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G)$ with probability of success at least, 
		\[
		\frac12 + \frac{p}{6 (p+1)},
		\]
		requires communication at least 
		
		\begin{equation*}
		s_p(n_p) := \min\Big\{\frac{c \cdot r_p \cdot t_p}{k^{(p-1)} \cdot (p+1)^2}, s_{p-1}(n_{p-1})\Big\} \textnormal{ for $p > 2$} \qquad \textnormal{ and }\qquad s_2(n_2) := \frac{c \cdot r_2 \cdot t_2}{9k},
		\end{equation*}
		for some absolute constant $c > 0$.

nodes.name: Lemma 6.16, Section 6.4, Section 6.6: Message of First Player Reveals Low Information Introduced in …
nodes.statement:
Message $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\Pi}}}}\xspace}_1$ cannot change the distribution of $(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G_{p-1}), \ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{spec}}}(G_{p-1}))$ too much.  Specifically, for any protocol $\ensuremath{\pi}$ where 
		\[
		CC(\ensuremath{\pi}) < \ensuremath{c_{\textnormal{msg}}} \cdot \frac{r_p \cdot t_p}{(p+1)^2 \cdot  k^{(p-1)}},
		\]
		for some absolute constant $\ensuremath{c_{\textnormal{msg}}}>0$, we have
		\[
		\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\|\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G_{p-1}), \ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{spec}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\Pi}}}}\xspace}_1, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace},\ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}}) - \ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G_{p-1}), \ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{spec}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}})\|}_{\mathrm{tvd}}} \leqslant \frac{1}{6(p+1)^2}.
		\]

nodes.name: Claim 6.24, Section 6.5: Distribution of Special Set Introduced in Proved in
nodes.statement:
For any $\ensuremath{\varepsilon} \in (0,1)$, in any protocol $\ensuremath{\pi}$ with  $$CC(\ensuremath{\pi}) < \ensuremath{\varepsilon}^2 \cdot (1/4k^{p-1}) \cdot r_p \cdot t_p \cdot \ensuremath{c_{\textnormal{\textsc{SI}}}},$$ we have, 
	\[
	\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\|\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{spec}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\Pi}}}}\xspace}_1,  \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}}) - \ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{spec}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid  \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}})\|}_{\mathrm{tvd}}} \leqslant \ensuremath{\varepsilon}.
	\]

nodes.name: Claim 6.25, Section 6.6: Distribution of Special Bit Introduced in Proved in
nodes.statement:
In any protocol $\ensuremath{\pi}$ for $\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(n,k)$, with  $$CC(\ensuremath{\pi}) < \ensuremath{\varepsilon}^2 \cdot r_p \cdot t_p \cdot \ensuremath{c_{\textnormal{\textsc{ind}}}}/  8 \cdot k^{(p-1)},$$ we have, 
		\[
		\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\|	\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\Pi}}}}\xspace}_1, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_1, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_2, \ldots, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_{t_p}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}}) - 	\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_p(\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsc{ans}}}(G_{p-1}) \mid \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{T}}}\xspace}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{i}}}\xspace^{\star}}, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_1, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_2, \ldots, \ensuremath{\ensuremath{{\mathsf{S}}}\xspace}_{t_p}, \ensuremath{\bm{\sigma}})\|}_{\mathrm{tvd}}} \leqslant \ensuremath{\varepsilon},
		\]
		where $\ensuremath{c_{\textnormal{\textsc{ind}}}}$ is the constant from 6.4.
